Full job description

A leading logistics company in the US is looking ofr Drayage Pricing Analyst to own the day-to-day pricing and quoting process for our container drayage services. You'll build and maintain rate sheets, calculate quotes for inbound/outbound moves, and make sure our pricing stays accurate, competitive, and profitable as fuel costs, chassis fees, and per-diem charges shift. This is an execution-focused role supporting sales and operations, not a strategy/carrier-negotiation position.

What You'll Do

Calculate and issue drayage rate quotes for container moves (port and rail ramp origin/destination)
Maintain and update rate sheets and pricing formulas across lanes and customers
Factor in accessorials, chassis fees, per-diem, detention, fuel surcharge (FSC), and other drayage-specific costs
Support the sales team with fast, accurate pricing turnaround for prospects and existing accounts
Flag rate discrepancies, margin issues, or lane-specific cost changes to management
Keep pricing documentation organized and consistent across regions/lanes

What You Need

Prior experience in drayage or intermodal pricing specifically. You should already know container drayage terminology and cost structure (chassis, per-diem, dray moves, port/rail ramp dynamics) without ramp-up time
Strong Excel/spreadsheet skills; comfort working with rate formulas and calculators
Attention to detail, pricing errors cost margin
Ability to turn around quotes quickly under sales team deadlines
Clear written communication for internal coordination

Nice to Have

Experience with fuel surcharge (FSC) tables and how they interact with base rates
Familiarity with routing/mileage tools used for rate calculation
Exposure to steel, breakbulk, or other project cargo drayage
